svg.title: Lina: system architecture
svg.desc: Caller talks to the Suisse Line agent, which calls the deterministic booking core in Azure Switzerland North through live tools; the core reads and writes the salon calendar. After each call a signed webhook triggers the call-reviewer agent, which uses Azure AI services as tools. Cancellations trigger the waitlist offer through the Suisse Line outbound agent.
svg.text: Lina · AI phone assistant for Salon Edelweiss
System architecture · all processing in Switzerland: Suisse Line (voice) + Azure Switzerland North (logic, agents, AI services)
